title: Safehouse and Drop
author: Silas Ashgrove
blurb: Ulyana Hartwell, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
